description:
[Deterministic customs carbon calculation. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates direct and indirect embedded greenhouse gas emissions (tCO2e) and projected EU ETS CBAM certificate purchase liabilities under Regulation (EU) 2023/956 across iron/steel, aluminium, cement, fertilizers, hydrogen, and electricity imports, factoring in carbon taxes already paid in country of origin.
Usage: Use this tool to calculate import carbon tariff exposure under EU CBAM rules. For enterprise Scope 1 & 2 carbon accounting, use 'csrd_esg_calculator' instead.
Returns: JSON object with { goodCategory: string, quantityMetricTons: number, totalEmbeddedEmissions_tCO2e: number, grossCbamLiabilityEur: number, netCbamLiabilityEur: number, etsPriceUsedEur: number }.

carbonPriceAlreadyPaidInOriginEurPerTon.description: Verified carbon tax or ETS price already paid in country of origin in EUR/t

countryOfOriginIso2.description: 2-letter ISO country code of origin (e.g. CN, IN, TR)

directEmissionsPerTon_tCO2e.description: Specific direct emission factor in tCO2e/t (default EU benchmark used if omitted)

goodCategory.description: CBAM Annex I aggregate goods category

indirectEmissionsPerTon_tCO2e.description: Specific indirect electricity emission factor in tCO2e/t

quantityMetricTons.description: Imported quantity in metric tons (net mass)

name: cbam_embedded_emissions
